name: H Shitai Ko o Mitsuketa Toki no xx Saiban ~Ore no Omoi, Kimi no Kokoro ni Todoke~
original_name: Hしたい娘を見つけた時の××裁判～俺の性欲、君の子宮に届け～
source:
A new law has been introduced called "Sex Trial System". If you find someone whom you want to have sex with, you tell them your theory. If they can't argue against it, you can have sex with them...

[From ErogeShop]
